name: OpenProject Tasks
author: helderrscorreia
description: Open assigned OpenProject work packages with priorities, time tracking (start/stop timer), and comment labels.

barWidget.description: Shows open tasks assigned to you with priorities, a running timer, start/stop controls, and comment labels.

schema.label: OpenProject URL
schema.description: Base URL of your instance, e.g. https://projects.example.com (no trailing /api).

schema.label: API token
schema.description: My account > Access tokens > + API Token. Sent as Basic apikey:token.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to refresh tasks and timer state.

schema.label: Max tasks
schema.description: Max open assigned work packages to fetch.
